justification: ANEF empty-overlay fall-through fix. _anef_field short-circuited to a blank postgis_overlays value whenever 'anef' was listed in covered_layers, never consulting the working anef_zones live query — so Sydney addresses (Mascot, Marrickville) reported a blank ANEF even though anef_zones holds the real contour (ANEF 35/30). One-line null-guard so an empty overlay falls through to the live query.

pre_impl.existing_data: fetch_anef_zone(lat,lng) queries anef_zones and returns the Sydney contour; verified live: Mascot -> ANEF 35, Haberfield -> ANEF 30. anef_value (intelligence_brief.py:2118) is the value of an overlay row with layer_type=='anef', None for most lots even when the LGA's anef layer is 'covered'.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The covered-check assumed 'covered' implies a usable value. In practice the anef overlay is covered but empty at most lots, so the brief short-circuited to a blank instead of using anef_zones.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new source or function — reuses the existing fetch_anef_zone fall-through that was already in the function but unreachable when 'anef' was covered. The guard `and anef_value is not None` re-enables it for the empty case.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Unchanged fail-safety: if anef_zones and the regional fetch both miss, the field still resolves to the honest 'no published ANEF contour' authoritative state; a failed query is caught and treated as None.
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A (backend Python). The field type and confidence semantics are unchanged.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: ANEF blank/null at Sydney addresses where the anef overlay is covered-but-empty (most of them). After: ANEF 35 (Sydney) / ANEF 30 (Sydney) from anef_zones; the overlay still wins when it actually has a value.

functions.name: _anef_field
functions.input: closure over covered (covered_layers), anef_value (overlay value or None), lat, lng
functions.output: a DataField for ANEF: the overlay value if present, else the anef_zones contour, else the regional contour, else an honest 'no published ANEF contour'
functions.if_none: when no source has a value the field is the authoritative 'no published ANEF contour' (not a silent blank); missing coords -> NOT_AVAILABLE

values: N/A - no hardcoded regulatory values. ANEF levels come from the anef_zones table (point-in-polygon) or the Protection overlay; nothing is hardcoded.
queries: No new query. Re-enables the existing fetch_anef_zone call for the covered-but-empty case.

break_it.scenario: 'anef' is in covered_layers but the overlay has no value at this lot (the common Sydney case)
break_it.what_happens: previously short-circuited to value=null source=postgis_overlays (a blank ANEF)
break_it.repro: test_anef_covered_but_empty_falls_through_to_zone: covered=['anef'], no overlay value, fetch_anef_zone returns 35
break_it.how: the guard `and anef_value is not None` lets it fall through to anef_zones -> 'ANEF 35 (Sydney)', source anef_zones

break_it.scenario: 'anef' is covered AND the overlay carries a real value
break_it.what_happens: the fix could wrongly override a valid ingested value with anef_zones
break_it.repro: test_anef_covered_with_value_still_uses_overlay: overlay value 'ANEF 25-30', fetch_anef_zone raises if called
break_it.how: the overlay value is non-null so the short-circuit still returns it; anef_zones is never queried

break_it.what_happens: a fall-through with no coords could crash the live query
break_it.repro: the lat/lng None branch returns NOT_AVAILABLE before any query (test_anef_missing_coords_is_not_available)
break_it.how: the existing coords guard runs immediately after the overlay short-circuit
